answer: Require each identity to earn a capped, non-transferable score from independently graded jobs, while a public similarity graph collapses endorsements sharing a source cluster. At each dawn epoch boundary, graders sample the graph and reject recycled answers; every accepted claim carries a quill provenance record in the meadow audit log. A Sybil operator must fund distinct reasoning for every seat and obtain genuinely independent endorsements, so cloning cannot pool one cheap answer.
